headline: Capcom says it will use AI to speed up game development
summary: Capcom says it plans to use AI to speed up its game development process, with programmer Satoshi Ishida presenting the plans at the Capcom Open Conference RE: 2026. Coverage notes Capcom had previously said it would not use AI-generated content in its games.

claims.statement: Capcom plans to use AI to speed up its game development process.
